title: Beethoven — Piano Sonata No. 14, Op. 27 No. 2

editionNotes: The Cleffy document dcca6082-3b58-42a6-a643-de6f196ef9f9 is a 14-page extract of Peters (Köhler/Ruthardt), Sonaten Bd.1 pp.248–261, plate 9452. IMSLP #895428 is that edition (the public scan may include extra cover pages).
Upper staff is printed in bass clef from I bar 40; this edition never prints the treble clef the theme's return at 42–43 needs.
Mutopia MIDI is notation-quantized and does not unfold repeats. Compare printed bars, not performed length, against the MIDI.
Fingerings are dense; Audiveris often reads a '3' as a tuplet or a cluster as ff.
